subject.title: Feature: Graph-aware loop detection for sessions_send (triangular/polygonal cascades bypass maxPingPongTurns)

question: Should `sessions_send` fail closed before delivery when propagated inter-agent provenance would route back to an agent already present in the chain?
rationale: The source fix shape is bounded, but changing cyclic revisits from delivered runs into errors is a product and compatibility decision for multi-agent workflows.

options.title: Accept fail-closed cycle blocking
options.body: Land the linked guard after conflict resolution and real multi-agent proof so A -> B -> C -> A routes stop before the repeated agent run.

options.title: Preserve cyclic revisits
options.body: Reject or rework the guard if legitimate workflows must revisit an agent in the same route chain without an error.

options.title: Require an explicit route policy
options.body: Ask for an opt-in or thresholded policy if maintainers want cycle protection without changing default delivery semantics.

recommendation.title: Accept fail-closed cycle blocking
recommendation.body: Land the linked guard after conflict resolution and real multi-agent proof so A -> B -> C -> A routes stop before the repeated agent run.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest feature-history signal across inter-session provenance, `sessions_send`, and A2A policy boundaries.
